comments.value: Many ideas in a single post is a bad idea.
As Docteh wrote... you've made if impossible to comment as each reply would be almost as long as your post. Maybe break them up.

I took the time to actually read this because maybe Tom did, a lot of what you've got in here is actually already requested, so make sure you upvote them if you come across them. 

Specifics of web projector might be worth sharing.

details:
01. Streaming Players:

I switched over to VRChat after Altspace died. So did maybe around 1,000 other users from altspace. But many of those users tried VRChat then they left to other platforms. One big reason why they don't want to stay on VRChat is their inability to use youtube and twitch via stand alone quest headsets. Not everyone can afford a PC to do PC VR. I don't understand why stand alone users are not able to see and hear youtube videos but i highly recommend this ability to be added. Many stand alone quest users use / need this feature for their events and for their karaoke worlds.

02. Web Projector:

The other feature that Altspace had which VRChat doesn't is a "Web Projector", an app we can install to our PC's to then project our desktop into VRChat. This has been a great way for many to share their desktops for many things, including events. Not having this feature means users need to leave VRchat and go to other platforms such as BigScreen. 

03. Event Page

Another issue with VRChat from the point of view of users of Altspace is the lack of event pages. The new group option VRChat added is the next best option and has it's uses. But it's not as nice as the Altspace event pages where you could browse an event section, see random public events, see what time they start and end. You can randomly join them any time. That allowed people to find live events, join in, meet new people. As well as create their own events. This alone would bring in new users to Altspace just to join these events. If VRChat added this, it would bring users to this platform just for the events alone.

04. Grabbing Objects:

One thing i personally hate about VRChat is how you grab objects.

If it's a single object, the grabbing works fine.

However, if there's more than one object next to each other. Grabbing an object becomes a nightmare. You end up grabbing the wrong objects and fighting with the objects to grab the correct object. I hope this can be fixed.

05. Portals:

If you go into a world and walk into a portal it sends you into that world as a public instance. I'd like to go into a random portal i find but i don't often want to go into a public instance of it.

So my suggestion, allow users to open their launch pad, then point at the portal, then the world info will quickly show up on the launch pad. From there users can now pick what kind of instance of that world they want to open up as a NEW portal or to join by themselves.

Other feedback i want to add, that i and many wish VRChat had.

01. The ability to spawn objects into your world to then basically decorate it. Building a world via Unity and Blender is fine but many users don't have PC's or the knowledge and skills to use those apps. Sometimes just being able to upload / use 3D objects, spawn them into a world is easier / faster. Like, being able to take a photo inside VRChat then quickly spawn the image into the world for everyone to see would be a nice feature.

Related topic, being able to take a photo and share that image to a user who is a friend via a message would be nice. (I'm not talking about the invite / request photo feature included with VRChat + i mean send photos inside messages anytime you want, a messaging system)

02. Messaging system:

VRchat is such a good platform and yet it has no direct messaging system like Altspace had. On Altspace you'd be able to message your friends / contacts back and forth. Inside of VR and on the website. Being able to direct message your friends inside of VR would make it easier to locate your friends, invite them places, have convos with them, share info. I realize that there is a messaging option inside of VRChat that let's you send a message for invites / request but it's just not enough.

03. Sharing / Selling Avatars:

The "Metaverse" is supposed to be the future of e-commerse where creators and brands can sell and people can go and buy. The lack of being able to pay for anything inside VRChat is one issue. 

The other issue is, many users like being able to make things then share it with users, either for free or at a cost.

If i make an avatar for someone, there's no easy & proper way for me to give them the avatar without making that user install unity and jump through hoops to upload their avatar they received from me.

So i recommend building in a system to let a user upload an avatar to then give to another user. When you share it, it quickly and easily installs into the buyers account. And if it's an item sold, VRChat can take a piece of the $ profit.

If VRchat had the ability to let users spawn in 3D objects to decorate worlds, then people can also share / sell world templates to users / buyers. So they can get these templates and decorate the world to make it their own.

-------------------

My last piece of feedback for now is. I hated VRChat when i first came on the platform, it was VERY confusing to use but i quickly learned. Then i realized if i use VRChat on my quest stand alone (No PC) i would crash every 5-10 minutes in any public worlds. So now i only do PC VR and it's been a much better experience. I know many PC VR users don't like quest stand alone users. But making the app as easy as possible and more quest friendly would help new users get comfortable with using VRChat. Many come on VRChat, get confused how to do things, crash often then they leave the platform.
title: VRChat Feedback (Many ideas)
